item.title: Amazon CloudFront now provides viewer ISP and post-quantum TLS details
item.description: Amazon CloudFront can now forward two new optional headers to your origin. The CloudFront-Viewer-ISP header contains the name of the viewer's internet service provider (ISP), so you can see which network a request came from. The CloudFront-Viewer-TLS-Details header describes the cryptography used on each viewer's TLS connection, so you can see whether a connection used post-quantum cryptography (PQC).
